sentence.en: Websites, custom software and automation, engineered to last.
sentence.el: Ιστοσελίδες, λογισμικό και αυτοματισμοί, σχεδιασμένα να διαρκούν.

set.name: Edition
set.mechanism: A sharp high-contrast serif wordmark in cobalt ink, with one cobalt-weight overline floating above IT: software presented with an editorial, premium hand, and the IT inside the name underlined from above.
set.expression_move: The overline above IT in the serif wordmark; everything else stays porcelain, ink and cobalt.
set.differs_by: Every reference uses a sans-serif and a symbol. Edition is wordmark-only and serif, a rare position (wordmarks are 3-15% of the library's software marks), reading as studio and partner rather than another startup.

logo.concept: ElIT set in a cut serif with a solid overline above IT: the name read as El + IT, a rule that later carries product names.

defaults_used.why: Flagged on Ink #0E1124, a near-black text colour with a blue tint so it sits with cobalt. It is not used as a navy brand colour; cobalt is the identifying colour.

rationale.claim: Serifs distinguish the I from the l, so ElIT reads correctly in a serif without any trick.
Wordmark-only marks are 3-15% of the library's developer, cloud and productivity logos, so this is an open position on the shelf.
A single deep cobalt as ink (rather than as a large surface) keeps the palette quiet so the type can speak.

findings.message: light: ext-1 #5ef0c0 is 1.33:1 on the light background #f7f7f4; as a stripe, chart series or thin line it needs 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)

suggested_fix.how: use ext-1-600 for stripes, chart series and thin lines

findings.message: light: border #d6d6d0 on background #f7f7f4 is 1.36:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)

suggested_fix.how: darken by OKLCH L -0.22, same hue

findings.message: dark: link #6892fb on text #f2f3f5 is 2.67:1, below 3.0:1 (underline links in dark mode (WCAG G183: without underline a link needs 3:1 against body text); WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: border #3b414d on background #0c0f18 is 1.87:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
Ou-Luo two-colour model scores #1838c9 + #0e1124 at -0.40 (negative = less harmonious on a grey CRT test, no context): model signal only; the pairing table in references/pairing.md takes precedence
Noto Serif Display misses 1/319 GF Latin Core codepoints (reach beyond the brief's languages)
findings.suggested_fix: matters only if the brand may add more Latin-script languages

findings.message: Noto Serif Display: ~105 KB WOFF2 for the brief's characters (one variable file, all weights; estimate)
Noto Sans: ~86 KB WOFF2 for the brief's characters (one variable file, all weights; estimate)
symbol-small at 16 px: features narrower than 1 px (lost 2.1 px², clogged 0.03 px²)
